newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO Pac up on assets injection hopes.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pac up on assets injection hopes.

text.p: Shares of China-backed container leasing and terminal operating firm COSCO Pacific Ltd rose on Monday on future asset injection hopes, brokers said.
The shares were up HK$0.50 or 4.63 percent at an all-time high of HK$11.30 at midday on volume of 7.31 million shares worth HK$81 million.
"Anticipation of possible future injection of ports operations fuelled demand for the stock," said Herbert Lau, analyst at Vickers Ballas.
Analysts said COSCO Pacific's earnings growth was seen as stable because most of its business comes from its parent.
They said COSCO Pacific and property group Lai Sun Development Co Ltd would both benefit after Lai Sun agreed to take a stake in COSCO Pacific.
Lai Sun Development has agreed to buy about 2.25 percent of COSCO Pacific from COSCO Investments Ltd for HK$477.05 million.

Lai Sun Development said the deal would diversify its asset and earning bases and pave the way for future business cooperation opportunities between the COSCO group and Lai Sun Development in both China and Hong Kong.
Lai Sun Development shares were up HK$0.40 or 4.49 percent to HK$9.30 at midday.
